remarks: AVAILABLE OCTOBER AND NOVEMBER 2024.   Experience Rowayton living at it's best in this iconic Five Mile River home, now available for rent for the first time ever! Move right into this classic waterfront 1890 victorian, newly renovated in May, 2024. This 2-acre level and fenced in property boasts a wrap around porch with incredible sunset water views. Enter to find a cozy living room with exposed beams, a gas burning fireplace, new furniture, a large smart TV and incredible views of Five Mile River. A bright and open bay window dining room is ready for gatherings with family and friends, and opens to the kitchen, which includes new appliances and flooring, fresh paint, and a kitchen island. Walk out from the kitchen to a fenced in side yard and porch with gas grill. Upstairs you will find a secluded large primary suite with views of Five Mile River, a walk in closet for even the most die hard clothing aficionado, and a renovated bathroom with walk in shower. Separately, you will find two additional bedrooms upstairs with views of Five Mile River, full closet space, and a renovated bathroom with full size tub. Do not miss this opportunity to spend your life on the water in coastal Rowayton! Walk to town, restaurants, and the beach. Leases may include a fully furnished summer or year long rental or a flexible un-furnished rental. Two car garage available for use. Beach passes and beach chairs included, along with linens and towels.
